metadata.title: Congress Is Rewriting the Rules for Data Centers. What It Means for Big Tech.<!-- --> - Barron's

content.text:
Congress Is Rewriting the Rules for Data Centers. What It Means for Big Tech.
Reining in data centers will be one of the first priorities of the new Congress when it convenes in a few weeks, with wide Democratic majorities.
